headline_item.title_zh: 英伟达高管致信董事会力挺黄仁勋
headline_item.title_en: Sources: Nvidia Developer Tech Director Nader Khalil wrote to board arguing that failing to reinstate Jensen Huang could cost Nvidia "irreplaceable talent" (Wall Street Journal)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 英伟达开发者技术总监Nader Khalil向董事会及数十名核心直属高管致信，警告若无法挽留首席执行官黄仁勋将导致不可替代的人才流失
headline_item.event_summary_en: Nader Khalil, Director of Developer Technology at Nvidia, formally addressed the company's board and approximately 60 of Jensen Huang’s direct reports, expressing grave concerns regarding the potential departure of CEO Jensen Huang. The letter contends that Huang’s exit would trigger a cascade of departures among irreplaceable technical talent, jeopardizing Nvidia’s dominance in the AI computing market.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达开发者技术总监Nader Khalil；英伟达董事会；首席执行官黄仁勋在英伟达企业内部管理层沟通渠道：致信警告董事会需挽留黄仁勋，否则面临核心人才流失的风险
【起因与机理】对公司当前高层动荡可能导致的研发体系崩溃及市场竞争力下滑的担忧
【核心事实细节】Nader Khalil代表技术部门向董事会施压要求挽留黄仁勋。
【各方立场与态度】信件被分发至60名直属高管，显示公司内部已出现针对管理权变动的分歧。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nader Khalil, Director of Developer Technology at Nvidia; Nvidia Board of Directors; CEO Jensen Huang: Sent a letter urging the board to retain Jensen Huang to prevent the loss of critical technical talent
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Concerns over the potential erosion of R&D capabilities and market competitiveness stemming from executive instability
[Key Fact Detail] Nader Khalil pressures the board to retain Jensen Huang on behalf of the tech team.
[Key Position & Outlook] Distribution of the letter to 60 direct reports indicates internal division regarding executive leadership transition.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此事件揭示了英伟达高度依赖“创始人驱动”的技术战略路径，黄仁勋在软硬协同开发体系中的领袖地位已转化为企业的系统性资产。若人才流失从管理层向底层架构师传导，将直接影响其CUDA生态的粘性，造成严重的商业连续性风险。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This incident highlights Nvidia's heavy reliance on a founder-driven strategic path, where Jensen Huang’s leadership is deeply embedded in the hardware-software co-design architecture. Should the talent attrition ripple from executive management down to core architects, it would threaten the stickiness of the CUDA ecosystem and create significant business continuity risks.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达警示客户：远程访问法案将收紧算力合规边界
headlines.title_en: Sources: Nvidia warns customers that the proposed Remote Access Security Act could subject chip buyers to US legal action if Chinese companies access AI chips (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达内部通知客户，《远程访问安全法案》可能使违规接入中国算力的各方均面临美国法律制裁，公司已通过限制出租比例应对
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia has warned customers that the proposed Remote Access Security Act (RASA) would expand export controls to cloud-based GPU access, subjecting both providers and users to U.S. legal action for non-compliance. To mitigate regulatory risk, Nvidia has implemented a strict policy prohibiting clients from renting out more than 50% of their GPU capacity to Chinese entities.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达（Nvidia）、美国众议院（提出法案）、美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）在美国云服务与全球数据中心算力租赁市场：拟通过RASA法案管控算力远程访问，并限制云服务商向中国客户租赁的算力比例不超过50%
【起因与机理】防止中国企业通过海外云端绕过物理出口管制，维持美国在人工智能基础设施领域的绝对垄断地位
【关键数据与实测】关键细节：英伟达强制实施50%出租红线，且RASA法案若在参议院通过将赋予政府云端执法权。
【涉及范围与推进】后续研判：全球云服务商将面临严苛的身份审核审计，算力基础设施的国际化供应链路将面临长期成本上涨。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nvidia, U.S. House of Representatives, U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS): Implementation of RASA to regulate remote GPU access; capping Chinese entity rentals at 50% capacity
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Preventing circumvention of physical export controls via cloud-based remote access to maintain U.S. AI superiority
[Key Metrics] Key details: Nvidia enforces a 50% rental cap; RASA, if enacted, grants the U.S. government direct enforcement authority over cloud services.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Outlook: Cloud providers face heightened identity auditing; international compute supply chains are likely to see sustained cost increases.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此举标志着美国出口管制体系从物理硬件销售向“算力服务即资产”的深度延伸，云服务商将从单纯的算力分销商转型为受美方监管的合规节点。对于算力密集型行业而言，这意味着全球云资源调度协议需经历重构，以应对日益严苛的溯源与配额审计，长期来看将进一步割裂全球统一的公共云市场。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This shift marks an evolution of U.S. export controls from hardware to 'compute-as-a-service,' forcing cloud providers to function as regulatory gatekeepers. This will necessitate a structural overhaul of global cloud resource allocation protocols, further fragmenting the public cloud market as compliance auditing becomes the primary bottleneck for operational expansion.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达组建国家安全与出口管制监督委员会
headlines.title_en: Nvidia's board establishes a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee to oversee national security policies, export control compliance, and more (Nvidia Newsroom)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达董事会设立专项委员会，旨在强化全球贸易风险管理及出口合规的董事会层级监管
headlines.event_summary_en: NVIDIA's Board of Directors has established the National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee, chaired by Suzanne Nora Johnson, with Stephen C. Neal and John O. Dabiri as members. This committee will provide direct board-level oversight for the company's National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team to manage global trade risks.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达(NVIDIA)董事会；委员会主席Suzanne Nora Johnson在企业治理架构层面：设立国家安全与出口管制监督委员会，将国家安全团队与贸易合规团队纳入委员会直接监管体系
【起因与机理】应对先进计算技术对国家安全影响的复杂挑战，确保在全球贸易监管环境下实现合规与业务平衡
【调查与监管诉求】核心动因：应对先进算力技术对国家安全带来的地缘政治合规挑战。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：强化供应链防御韧性，降低因合规性缺失带来的全球化业务中断风险。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] NVIDIA Board of Directors; Suzanne Nora Johnson (Chair) (Corporate governance): Established a new committee to oversee the National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address national security challenges posed by advanced AI silicon and navigate tightening global trade regulations
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Core driver: Addressing geopolitical compliance risks surrounding advanced AI silicon.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Outlook: Strengthening supply chain resilience to minimize operational disruptions under strict trade regulations.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此举标志着英伟达将地缘政治合规性从行政运营提升至最高决策维度，意在通过董事会直接介入，减少因出口政策突变导致的技术脱钩风险。这不仅是对美国商务部出口管制政策的制度化响应，也是为了在应对持续收紧的监管审查时，能够通过更专业、更具透明度的治理架构获取政府侧的信任红利。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This move signals the elevation of geopolitical compliance from operational routine to top-tier strategic governance, aimed at mitigating technical decoupling risks from sudden policy shifts. It serves as both a proactive institutional alignment with US export controls and a mechanism to secure regulatory credibility by institutionalizing oversight in response to intensifying geopolitical scrutiny.

RT @halcyonrayes：我要求 claude 在 cuda c++ 中完全实现 trellis.2，它比原始 pytorch 实现快 5.3 倍 🚀

令人惊讶的是，glb-export 函数是瓶颈，而不是神经网络本身。将导出转移到 GPU 带来的收益比其他任何东西都多。

- 它仍然提供了 2.2 倍更好的性能，同时按位相同🎯

将其用作代理优化模型的来源，或直接使用它。黑客快乐！ 🤗
titans.quote_en:
RT @halcyonrayes: i asked claude to implement trellis.2 fully in cuda c++, and it is 5.3x faster than the original pytorch implementation 🚀 

surprisingly, the glb-export function was the bottleneck, not the neural net itself. moving exporting to the gpu gave more gains than anything else.

- zero python runtime, all in c++ ⚡️
- cost 💵 ? ~$7 on claude and ~$60 on compute for testing on h200s through @huggingface jobs 
- it still gave 2.2x better perf while being bitwise identical 🎯

the code is open-sourced for use here -- https://t.co/YDxMFveRnC

use it as a source for your agent to optimize your models, or utilize it directly. happy hacking! 🤗
